identity_evidence.adapter_config.adapter_path: poetry/canon/adapter — the path the script names

🔴_WHAT_IS_NOT_PROVEN: that THIS is the adapter that produced the committed selection_7d.json. That artifact records n, mean_persona, g2p_holds and scale — and NO ADAPTER HASH. So identity with the original run cannot be established, only consistency with the path and config the script names. Any 7d number I produce is therefore a NEW measurement on this adapter, not a reproduction of the old one, and I will report it that way.
